audit_metadata.auditor: Senior AI/IR Research Engineer & Publication Architect

research_explorer_hybrid_search.notes: Renders search UI, domain pills, and progress panels. Backend API calls are implemented, but poll-based state transitions can trigger false zero-result flashes before completion.

ai_assistant_ask_workspace.notes: Fully hooked to backend /api/ai/ask endpoint with support for hybrid/semantic search modes and structured context selection.

synthesis_workspace.notes: Invokes LiteratureSynthesisEngine via /api/ai/ask (mode='synthesis') across selected scope.

xai_trace_inspector.notes: Renders static trace logs (trace_dump.json / status_dump.json). Dedicated backend endpoint /api/ai/explain is an un-implemented stub returning hardcoded JSON.

evaluation_console.notes: Renders evaluation dashboards and metrics tables, but backend evaluation_service.py uses mock simulated functions (_simulate_retriever) instead of real retrieval and LLM calls.

personal_research_corpus.notes: Supports PDF ingestion, PyMuPDF extraction, semantic chunking, and isolated ChromaDB vector indexing.

ai_api_router.notes: Dispatches ask, compare, synthesis, and iterative RAG requests to core assistant engines.

papers_search_api.notes: Executes background search, polls LocalEvidenceRetriever and dynamic online connectors (arXiv, PMC, OpenAlex, NASA ADS, Crossref).

retrieval_engine_chroma_bm25_rrf.notes: Implements BM25Okapi, ChromaDB vector querying, Reciprocal Rank Fusion (k=60), and BGE CrossEncoder reranking.

local_evidence_retriever.notes: Provides high-throughput hybrid retrieval with detailed provenance trace data over local KB (670 papers, 14,850 chunks).

context_manager.notes: Validates mode/scope combinations, enforces single-paper/compare constraints, and computes SHA-256 context_hash.

enhanced_rag_service.notes: Executes bounded evidence construction, deduplication, Gemini 2.5 Flash generation, and structural citation validation.

claim_verifier_and_repair.notes: Two-stage verification (Stage A regex/numerical check, Stage B Gemini entailment classification) plus conservative citation repair.

iterative_rag_service.notes: Executes up to 2 refinement cycles based on self-feedback taxonomy and targeted re-retrieval.

evaluation_service.notes: Evaluation service relies on simulated retriever outputs (_simulate_retriever) and hardcoded metric approximations rather than real execution over ds_nexus_v10.

sqlite_postgres_models.notes: Database models for Paper, PaperChunk, SearchExperiment, EvaluationDataset, EvaluationItem, EvaluationExperiment, ResearchSession.

chroma_vector_store.notes: Persistent Chroma collection researchnexus_local_v1_bgebase containing 14,850 768-dim BGE embeddings.

bm25_serialized_index.notes: Serialized BM25Okapi index and mapping dict for local KB chunks.
